theme_and_archetype.domain: Fintech / Personal Finance for Indian Masses
theme_and_archetype.selected_archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play)
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Financial apps for the Indian demographic need to move away from cold, corporate SaaS blues. They must evoke trust, warmth, and approachability. The 'Vibrant Play' elements add gamification (streaks, badges) to encourage engagement, while 'Organic & Earthy' ensures the platform feels grounded and safe. Cultural resonance is achieved through warm Saffron, Marigold, and Terra Cotta tones against an Off-White/Bone base.

rules: No pure black or pure white backgrounds. Tint everything towards warm sand or espresso.
The 'premium' section must use Deep Maroon (#880E4F) instead of purple to evoke Indian royalty and wealth.
Success states (saving money, high scores) use natural Tulsi green (#2E7D32).

font_families.heading: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: Nunito, Noto Sans Devanagari, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use 'Outfit' for all numbers, balances, and headings. It feels highly geometric but extremely friendly.
Use 'Nunito' for reading text. Its rounded terminals feel soft and non-judgmental.

Crucial for India: Rely on standard system fallbacks for multi-language script rendering (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, etc.). Keep line-heights generous (leading-relaxed) because Indic scripts require more vertical breathing room.

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8), prioritizing p-6 for default mobile container padding.

grid_strategy.mobile: grid-cols-1 or grid-cols-2 for bento widgets

rules: Bento Grid for Dashboard: Use asymmetrical blocks. E.g., 'Money Score' takes full width (col-span-2), 'Quick Cash' and 'Streaks' take half widths (col-span-1).
Card Design: 'Clay & Crisp'. Use solid white backgrounds, rounded-3xl, ambient shadow, and a 1px border of #EEDDCC to ground them.
Mobile-First: Everything must be reachable with one thumb. Heavy reliance on bottom-sheet interactions.

navigation_bar.style: Fixed bottom-0, inset-x-4, mb-6 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-full border border-border_light shadow-lifted flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4
navigation_bar.special_element: Floating Action Button (FAB) in the center for Voice Input (Mic), elevated and colored in primary Saffron.

money_score_gauge.style: Half-circle gauge (Recharts PieChart startAngle=180 endAngle=0) or an SVG arc. Big friendly typography in the center. Gradient stroke from Orange to Green based on health.
money_score_gauge.animation: Framer Motion layout animations to count up from 0 to actual score on mount.

money_school_card.style: bg-secondary/10 rounded-3xl p-6 border border-secondary/20 flex flex-row items-center justify-between. Use Lucide GraduationCap or BookOpen icon.

budget_progress_bars.style: Thick, rounded-full track (bg-surface_secondary) with a vibrant fill (primary/success). Include a fire emoji 🔥 or an alert icon ⚠️ if nearing limits.

language_picker.style: Bottom sheet sliding up, showing a grid of 10 Indian languages with native script rendering (English, हिन्दी, বাংলা, తెలుగు, தமிழ், etc.).

screens.splash_and_onboarding: Uses 3D claymation generated images. Swipeable Framer Motion cards. Warm, celebratory, welcoming.
screens.auth_screen: Trust-building. OTP-based (common in India). Clean numpad, prominent 'Secure' lock icon, reassuring text.
screens.home_dashboard: Glanceable. 'Hello, [Name]' header. Money Score gauge is the hero. Horizontally scrolling 'Money School' lessons. Recent transactions list. Central FAB for voice.
screens.transactions: Quick Cash bar (fast add predefined amounts: ₹10, ₹50, ₹100). Voice input dialog ('I spent 50 rupees on chai'). Colorful category badges.
screens.insights: AI insights cards ('You saved 20% more this week! 🎉'). Expense donut chart using Recharts. Trend lines.
screens.budget: Category budgets. Visual progress bars. Friendly alerts ('Careful, dining out is 80% used!').
screens.rewards_and_premium: Gamification hub. Flame icon for streaks, SVG badges. 'Share on WhatsApp / Instagram Story' buttons. Premium paywall uses Deep Maroon (#880E4F), gold gradients, and a regal aesthetic.
screens.profile: Settings, Language Picker, Avatar. Clean list items with Lucide icons on the left, chevron on the right.

images.description: Abstract warm gradient background, Indian festive colors, elegant smooth texture.
3D claymation style illustration of a happy Indian family saving money, marigold and terracotta palette.
3D claymation style illustration of a glowing gold coin with a rising graph, Indian festive context.
3D claymation style illustration of an ornate, welcoming Indian doorway (Toran) opening to a bright future.
Portrait of an Indian user for the profile screen.

motion_and_interactions.gestures: Add whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} to all cards, buttons, and list items to give a tactile, gamified feel.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Slide horizontally for onboarding. Fade and scale up for dialogs and modals.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Celebrate streak milestones with react-confetti. Add a pulsing animation (scale 1 to 1.05 infinitely) to the Voice Input mic when active.

icons.rules: Use strokeWidth={2.5} for a chunkier, friendlier appearance. Avoid thin, clinical icons.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast on primary Saffron background meets WCAG AA standards (use white text on #E65100).
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: All interactive elements MUST be at least 48x48px.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='voice-input-button', data-testid='money-score-value', data-testid='language-select-hindi').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app using React JS, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Implement the provided JSON color palette tightly into tailwind.config.js.
Use framer-motion extensively for playful, tactile feedback on all tappable cards.
Use react-router-dom for navigation. Set up an app shell where the bottom dock navigation is persistent for authenticated routes.
Prioritize the UI execution for the 'Home Dashboard', 'Transactions', 'Insights', and 'Rewards' screens.
Ensure the Money Score gauge feels alive and central. Use Recharts for insights and the gauge.
Use the generated media_urls exactly as provided for onboarding slides and the splash screen. Do NOT use placeholder domains.
